title: Rebuild shared interior backing masks after Canvas2D restoration

finding.trigger: A cached opaque-interior backing surface loses and restores its context; restoration clears pixels but the image/color WeakMap returns the same now-empty canvas without rebuilding.
finding.observed: Confirmed source contract defect; no physical-device reproduction or timing claim.

behavior: Read native image dimensions once at surface creation; keep accepted surface dimensions for recovery.
Avoid native isContextLost polling on healthy event-supported cache hits; feature detection requires both context event properties and addEventListener.
Keep one surface per existing weak image/color owner; loss never allocates replacement canvases or scans pixels on every frame.
Skip only unavailable backing submission; preserve original actor image, simulation and geometry.
After events or native isContextLost state confirm restoration, lazily rebuild the same interior-only mask on the next normal paint.
Event callbacks are created in a separate image-free helper; no source image, variants Map or global owner subscription is captured.
Keep null-context and readback failures visible; failed initial surfaces are not retained as valid cache entries.
No preventDefault, scene pause integration, timers, policy changes, or eager recovery readback.

cases: HTMLCanvas and OffscreenCanvas event recovery, repeated loss/restoration, stable geometry and exact mask pixels
No loss APIs and unchanged disc geometry; generic event-target support retains native fallback
Event-capable healthy cache hits do not poll native loss state
Native state wins over premature restoration event
Context creation and readback failures remain visible and late old events cannot invalidate replacement

validation.method: RAM-only Prettier, Acorn AST and ESLint; no module/application/test execution
validation.generatedProjection: No body-backing/paintBodyBacking/interiorAlphaMask occurrence in fixed-main world-reaction-runtime.mjs or sim-presentation.mjs; play-shell generator finite input list excludes it.
remaining: Remote controls and full source/build validation.
This helper-only repair does not add scene pause/explicit Resume for independently lost mask surfaces, so full owned-surface recovery is not completed.
